body.name: finite contact-stratified certificate handle
body.construction: Start with exact rational input encoding and construct finitely many rational polyhedral cells in observable share--intensity coordinates and maintained nuisance coordinates. Attach a total endpoint-grid policy table to each observable cell and outward-rounded rational Poisson tail, exponential, target-membership, coverage, and risk enclosures to every verification cell. Resolve nominal-coverage and target-endpoint contacts by the fixed-profile equations \(dp_a-\kappa p_a\,dM=0\), refine undecided cells, and record a complete exact mixed-integer branch-and-bound tree with integral incumbents or rational dual bounds at every leaf. The target object is a finite certificate accepted by \(\operatorname{Verify}\), including the mandated early-kill input.
